title: langchain-milvus 0.4.0 requires pymilvus 3.x; all matching releases blocked by release-age cooldown
error_summary: Fromager cannot resolve pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0 (dependency of langchain-milvus 0.4.0): all candidates published within 3-day cooldown window (oldest is 2 days old)
suggested_resolution_summary: Wait ~1 day for cooldown to clear and re-run, or pin langchain-milvus to 0.3.3 in collection constraints to avoid pymilvus 3.x until ready
confidence_justification: The x86_64 error message directly states the cause: 2 pymilvus candidates found for <4.0,>=3.0.0 but all rejected by the 3-day release-age cooldown (oldest is 2 days old). The aarch64 error ('no match found searching for sdists') is consistent with the same root cause under a different resolver code path or timing. Cross-job consistency confirms the failure is systematic, not transient. PyPI confirms langchain-milvus 0.4.0 (released 2026-07-17) requires pymilvus<4.0,>=3.0.0, and this is the first version to require pymilvus 3.x.
target_repo_reason: The fix (pinning langchain-milvus or adding a pymilvus constraint) lives in the collection constraints files under collections/rhai/*/constraints.txt, which are in the pipeline repository.

references.description: Contains the unversioned langchain-milvus entry (AIPCC-10403) that caused fromager to resolve to version 0.4.0.
Checked for existing pymilvus or langchain-milvus constraints; none found, confirming no prior pin was in place.
